user.title: Configure PLCBus
user.description: Configure one PLCBUS serial adapter. Leave the device blank to detect a Prolific PL2303 adapter. Leave units blank to discover devices in houses A-K.

data_description.user_code: Exactly two hexadecimal digits, from 00 to FF.
data_description.unit: For example A1,A2,B6. Houses A-P and units 1-16.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure PLCBus
reconfigure.description: Changing these settings reloads the integration. Remove any legacy PLCBUS YAML configuration after import.

data_description.user_code: Exactly two hexadecimal digits, from 00 to FF.
data_description.unit: For example A1,A2,B6. Leave blank for automatic discovery.

error.invalid_config: Enter a two-digit hexadecimal user code and valid units (A-P, 1-16). If no adapter is detected, specify its serial device path.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to detect the serial adapter. Check the device path and permissions.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one PLCBus connection can be configured. Reconfigure the existing integration.
abort.invalid_config: The YAML configuration is invalid or no serial adapter was detected.
